- savings: save0 = keep current spending; save5 = save 5 more points of salary while working; save10 = save 10 more points of salary while working

- claim: claimret = claim Social Security at retirement; claimfra = claim Social Security at full retirement age; claim70 = claim Social Security at 70
- drawdown: conventional = draw down in the default order; bracketfill = fill the 12% bracket from the pre-tax 401k each retired year
